This 2020 Ford F-350SD Lariat in white combines professional-grade capability with luxury appointments, delivering a truck that works as hard as it commands respect on the road.

- Chrome Package with 2 front tow hooks, chrome mirror caps, and chrome step bars
- FX4 Off-Road Package with hill descent control and off-road-tuned shock absorbers
- Pro Trailer Backup Assist with 360-degree camera system and trailer reverse guidance
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof with map lights and moonroof switches
- 7.3L V8 PFI engine with 385 horsepower and 10-speed automatic transmission
- Lariat Value Package featuring power heated and ventilated front seats with memory
- PowerScope Trailer Tow Mirrors with heat and memory functions
- SYNC 3 communications system with B&O audio by Bang & Olufsen and SiriusXM
- LED box lighting and LED roof clearance lights
- 20 Chrome PVD aluminum wheels
- Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System with rear view and 360-degree coverage
- 397-amp alternators and dual 78 AH battery for heavy-duty demands
- Six upfitter switches for customizable accessories
- 4-Wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control
- Universal garage door opener and remote start system

The powertrain delivers serious capability with the 7.3L V8 producing 385 horsepower, paired with a robust 10-speed automatic transmission and 4-wheel drive. The electronic-locking rear differential with 3.73 axle ratio ensures optimal traction whether you're towing, hauling, or navigating challenging terrain. Heavy-duty components throughout including the 397-amp alternators and dual battery system are engineered to handle substantial work demands without compromise.

For those who venture off the beaten path, the FX4 Off-Road Package delivers specialized equipment: hill descent control manages steep grades with precision, off-road-tuned shock absorbers absorb rough terrain, and protective skid plates shield critical components. Transfer case and fuel tank protection ensures durability in demanding environments. The Chrome Package adds visual appeal with chrome tow hooks, step bars, mirror caps, and a chrome exhaust tip, while the 20-inch chrome PVD wheels provide a refined aesthetic.

Comfort and convenience define the cabin experience. Power heated and ventilated front seats with memory functions automatically adjust to your preferences each time you enter. The twin panel power moonroof floods the interior with light and fresh air. Climate control includes automatic temperature regulation with dual front zones and rear window defrosting. The leather-trimmed steering wheel, tilt and telescoping steering column, and memory power-adjustable pedals create a personalized driving environment tailored to your needs.

Technology integration simplifies both daily driving and complex towing scenarios. SYNC 3 connects your smartphone for seamless communication and entertainment, while the B&O audio system delivers premium sound quality complemented by SiriusXM satellite radio. The Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System includes a 360-degree camera view, rear camera, and trailer reverse guidance Pro Trailer Backup Assist takes the guesswork out of backing up trailers by providing visual guidance on the touchscreen. Remote start allows you to prepare the truck before stepping outside, and the universal garage door opener means one less remote to carry.

This F-350SD Lariat stands ready to exceed your expectations, whether your priorities lean toward professional utility, weekend adventures, or commanding presence. With a complete package of capability, protection, and refinement, this truck welcomes serious consideration from buyers who understand what premium heavy-duty trucks deliver.
